name: Increase file read token limit
description: Raises Claude Code's FileReadTool per-file output token limit (DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS) from 25000 to 99999, letting the Read tool return larger files before truncating. Derived from tweakcc's increaseFileReadLimit patch; capped at 99999 to remain byte-length-neutral for in-place binary patching.

operations.rationale: DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS (=25000) is the FileReadTool read limit (cc-2188 tools/FileReadTool/limits.ts:18). The bare '=25000,' occurs 4x in the binary, so it is disambiguated by the adjacent bundled AUTO_MEM_DISPLAY_NAME="auto memory" literal, yielding a single unique match. Minified ids are churned, so they are preserved via backrefs while only the 5-digit value is swapped.
